name: es_named_reloc_census
purpose: Image-wide census of pool/label relocation defects that NO score in this project can see: real drops every R_PPC line, --clean and reloc_set_delta both normalise lbl_* and @N to <local>, and objdiff fuzzy scored damage_enemy at 99.22 confirm every one against 'fnasm <unit> <fn> 0xA:0xB --diff' before editing. The tool pairs relocations only inside difflib EQUAL runs over register-erased instruction text - equal instruction COUNT is NOT alignment and an earlier count-only version fabricated a wrong-symbol row on MBOX_AllocModelMem (102/102 with a 2-instruction drift). It reports only lbl-vs-lbl pairs, so a permutation in which our side is an anonymous @N pool entry shows as WRONG or not at all - read the anonymous side with 'pooldump.py --ours <unit> @N' before believing a WRONG row. Section matters: a .sdata/.sbss/.bss label is a mutable global and must never be literalised (claim.law.pool-literal-sweep-section-and-lvalue-preconditions.20260831.v1).
